description: baseline: physics features + site z-scores + balanced HGB (published model)
add log band energies (6 FFT bands x 13 signals): PI-gain fault changes oscillation, not mean
add waveform shape stats (skew, kurtosis, peak-to-peak per signal): distortion before the mean moves
drop the 13 absolute signal means: slow healthy drift moves them (suspected false-alarm source)
feed both raw features and site z-scores: let the trees pick absolute or site-relative splits
regularise HGB (lr 0.05, 300 iters, depth 4, min leaf 10, l2 1.0): ~35 fit windows per fault class
sqrt-balanced class weights instead of balanced: full balance weights faults ~8x and over-calls healthy windows
retry raw + site z-scores on the sqrt-weight base (exp 4 failed on false alarms caused by weighting)
class weights at balanced^0.25 (from ^0.5): continue the false-alarm direction
causal history: std of each feature over the last 5 windows (~0.5 s) to see slow PI-gain oscillation
finer spectrum: split 10-45 Hz controller band, add 5th/7th grid harmonics (inverter switching faults)
model family: ExtraTrees (500 trees, sqrt weights) instead of HGB; random splits overfit less on ~35/class
soft-vote HGB + ExtraTrees: boosting over-calls faults, ExtraTrees under-calls; average the probabilities
robust site baseline (median / IQR instead of mean / std): transient healthy windows skew the reference
combine near-misses: raw + site z features (exp 7) with HGB + ExtraTrees soft vote (exp 12)
add the 1D-CNN (raw waveforms, train.py) as a third soft-vote member: deep learning view of the signals
augment fit set with half-shifted windows from consecutive same-plant same-class fit windows (~2x data)
add RandomForest as a third soft-vote member (bootstrap trees: different errors from ExtraTrees and HGB)
